partition: four repeatedly consumed obstacle-enabled track-1 TRAIN geometries, not a fresh/protected or official study

train_episodes_since_70k.limitation: Eight training finishes on three repeatedly consumed roads came from continuously changing on-policy learner/planner/noise. This is NOT a final frozen-policy finish rate or independent generalization evidence.

reward_target_exposure.limitation: Only replay's training reward/Q target changed; the official environment and raw episode rewards were preserved. This verifies delivered intervention dose, not its causal driving effect.

fixed_seed_train_probe.limitation: Identical seed input windows lacked damage and positive terminals; this probe does not test model fit on penalized transitions or terminal-event recall. Never treat its shaped reward MAE as a like-for-like RAW H3 real-return ranking comparison.

frozen_policy_comparison.limitation: Both treatment MPPI finishes were repeats of one of four heavily used road geometries; 2/8 is below the local 4/8 descriptive goal and cannot establish fresh-road or official generalization. See independent evaluation receipt for all sixteen raw-outcome road/mode records.

causal_comparison_limit: RAW and DAMAGE first10k replay observations/actions/rewards/flags/probe match byte-for-byte, yet the very first planned action at decision10001 already differs before the first penalty at22123. Model/optimizer/RNG state at exactly10k was not frozen; a one-learner-seed difference between evolving trajectories is not an action/transition-matched treatment effect. Independent learner-seed and same-arm raw/raw controls would be required before causal attribution.
decision: Preserve the complete single-axis source and raw full-episode result; no official model promotion or >=50% claim. Before a separately pinned planner-H5/source H5 single-axis study, check no-reset H5 reward/terminal/Q calibration on RAW 100k world model and validate actual H5 branch returns under a bounded consumed-TRAIN prefix protocol if appropriate. Do not stack damage shaping with H5 or MPPI sample changes, relabel raw H3 branch returns as shaped/H5 ground truth, or open reserved/protected evaluation cells. The fresh multi-track TRAIN-DIAGNOSTIC allocator remains BLOCKED; cross-lane-consumed reuse is a weaker future development target only after an exact-cell exposure audit.
